notes: This portable C++ TCK slice composes adapter-supplied application and update-rate FOM modules. A subject federate subscribes to one object-class attribute and one application interaction class; a separate requester subscribes to the three standard MIM report interactions, then names the subject with the inherited HLAfederate parameter of HLArequestSubscriptions. The test validates the standard object-class, interaction-class, and empty directed-interaction subscription reports. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, public handle decoders, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. The provider package, FOM modules, names, endpoint, callback configuration, update-rate name, and logical-time implementation come from the adapter. It does not use DDM regions, private headers, provider registries, or vendor-specific names.
